18.title: Update Log
18.body:
KNOWN BUGS / ISSUES: Sometimes things clip through the player trays (especially when taking one card off a stack of two). Considered low priority as stuff respawns when falling out of the world.

- First release candidate created

- Original outer track title deed and no sao modification title deed sets have had the subboard properties added in Goodie Bag

Chelsea Harbor
Delta Basin

function setToken(theButton, theClicker)
  local playerNum = getPlayerNum(theButton)
  if playerNum == 0 then
    print('ERROR: Claim: How did you click this?')
    return
  end

  if playerData[playerNum].Color != theClicker and theClicker != "Black" then
    broadcastToColor("This is not yours", theClicker, {1,1,1})
    return
  end

  local objectsList = playerData[playerNum].ClaimTokenZone.getObjects()
  if #objectsList < 2 then
    broadcastToColor("No Token in Zone", theClicker, {1,1,1})
    return
  else
    if #objectsList > 2 then
      broadcastToColor("Too many objects in Zone", theClicker, {1,1,1})
      return
    else
      local hasFoundButton = false
      for k, v in next, objectsList do
          if v == theButton then
            hasFoundButton = true
          else
			if playerData[playerNum].token == nil then
				broadcastToColor("Successfully claimed token!", theClicker, {1,1,1})
			else
				broadcastToColor("Successfully updated token!", theClicker, {1,1,1})
			end
			playerData[playerNum].token = v.getGUID()
			v.setColorTint(playerData[playerNum].color)
          end
      end
      if hasFoundButton == false then
        broadcastToColor("Put the pedestal back", theClicker, {1,1,1})
        return
      end
    end
  end
end

function whereAmI(theButton, theClicker)
  local playerNum = getPlayerNum(theButton)
  if playerNum == 0 then
    print('ERROR: Claim: How did you click this?')
    return
  end

  if playerData[playerNum].Color != theClicker and theClicker != "Black" then
    broadcastToColor("This is not yours", theClicker, {1,1,1})
    return
  end
  
  local token = playerData[playerNum].token
  
  if token == nil then
	broadcastToColor("You must select a token first!", theClicker, {1,1,1})
  else
    obj = getObjectFromGUID(token)
    Player[theClicker].pingTable(obj.getPosition())
  end
end

function getPlayerNum(theButton)
  local playerNum = 0
  local ctr = 0
  for k, v in next, playerData do
    ctr = ctr + 1
    if theButton == v.ButtonChip then
        playerNum = ctr
    end
  end
  return playerNum
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
tableHeightOffset = -9

function onSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode({tid=tableImageData, cd=checkData})
    --saved_data = ""
    return saved_data
end

function onload(saved_data)
    --Loads the tracking for if the game has started yet
    if saved_data ~= "" then
         local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
         tableImageData = loaded_data.tid
         checkData = loaded_data.cd
    else
        tableImageData = {}
        checkData = {move=false, scale=false}
    end

    --Disables interactable status of objects with GUID in list
    for _, guid in ipairs(ref_noninteractable) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then obj.interactable = false end
    end

    --Establish references to table parts
    obj_leg1 = getObjectFromGUID("afc863")
    obj_leg2 = getObjectFromGUID("c8edca")
    obj_leg3 = getObjectFromGUID("393bf7")
    obj_leg4 = getObjectFromGUID("12c65e")
    obj_surface = getObjectFromGUID("4ee1f2")
    obj_side_top = getObjectFromGUID("35b95f")
    obj_side_bot = getObjectFromGUID("f938a2")
    obj_side_lef = getObjectFromGUID("9f95fd")
    obj_side_rig = getObjectFromGUID("5af8f2")

    controlActive = false
    createOpenCloseButton()
end



--Activation/deactivation of control panel



--Activated by clicking on
function click_toggleControl(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        if not controlActive then
            --Activate control panel
            controlActive = true
            self.clearButtons()
            createOpenCloseButton()
            createSurfaceInput()
            createSurfaceButtons()
            createScaleInput()
            createScaleButtons()
        else
            --Deactivate control panel
            controlActive = false
            self.clearButtons()
            self.clearInputs()
            createOpenCloseButton()

        end
    end
end




--Table surface control



--Changes table surface
function click_applySurface(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        updateSurface()
        broadcastToAll("New Table Image Applied", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Saves table surface
function click_saveSurface(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        local nickname = self.getInputs()[1].value
        local url = self.getInputs()[2].value
        if nickname == "" then
            --No nickname
            broadcastToAll("Please supply a nickname for this save.", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
        else
            --Nickname exists

            if findInImageDataIndex(url, nickname) == nil then
                --Save doesn't exist already
                table.insert(tableImageData, {url=url, name=nickname})
                broadcastToAll("Image URL saved to memory.", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
                --Refresh buttons
                self.clearButtons()
                createOpenCloseButton()
                createSurfaceButtons()
                createScaleButtons()
            else
                --Save exists already
                broadcastToAll("Memory already contains a save with this Name or URL. Delete it first.", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            end
        end
    end
end

--Loads table surface
function click_loadMemory(_, color, index)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        self.editInput({index=0, value=tableImageData[index].name})
        self.editInput({index=1, value=tableImageData[index].url})
        updateSurface()
        broadcastToAll("Table Image Loaded", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Deletes table surface
function click_deleteMemory(_, color, index)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        table.remove(tableImageData, index)
        self.clearButtons()
        createOpenCloseButton()
        createSurfaceButtons()
        createScaleButtons()
        broadcastToAll("Element Removed from Memory", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
    end
end

--Updates surface from the values in the input field
function updateSurface()
    local customInfo = obj_surface.getCustomObject()
    customInfo.diffuse = self.getInputs()[2].value
    obj_surface.setCustomObject(customInfo)
    obj_surface = obj_surface.reload()
end



--Table Scale control



--Applies Scale to table pieces
function click_applyScale(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        local newWidth = tonumber(self.getInputs()[3].value)
        local newDepth = tonumber(self.getInputs()[4].value)
        if type(newWidth) ~= "number" then
            broadcastToAll("Invalid Width", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif type(newDepth) ~= "number" then
            broadcastToAll("Invalid Depth", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif newWidth<0.1 or newDepth<0.1 then
            broadcastToAll("Scale cannot go below 0.1", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        elseif newWidth>12 or newDepth>12 then
            broadcastToAll("Scale should not go over 12 (world size limitation)", {0.9,0.2,0.2})
            return
        else
            changeTableScale(math.abs(newWidth), math.abs(newDepth))
            broadcastToAll("Scale applied.", {0.2,0.9,0.2})
        end
    end
end

--Checks/unchecks move box for hands
function click_checkMove(_, color)
    if permissionCheck(color) then
        local find_func = function(o) return o.click_function=="click_checkMove" end
        if checkData.move == true then
            checkData.move = false
            local buttonEntry = findButton(self, find_func)
            self.editButton({index=buttonEntry.index, label=""})
        else
            checkData.move = true
            local buttonEntry = findButton(self, find_func)
            self.editButton({index=buttonEntry.index, label=string.char(10008)})
        end
    end
end

--Alters scale of elements and moves them
function changeTableScale(width, depth)
    --Scaling factors used to translate scale to position offset
    local width2pos = (width-1) * 18
    local depth2pos = (depth-1) * 18

    --Hand zone movement
    if checkData.move == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                moveHandZone(Player[pc], width2pos, depth2pos)
            end
        end
    end
    --Hand zone scaling
    --The button to enable this was disabled for technical reasons
    if checkData.scale == true then
        for _, pc in ipairs(ref_playerColor) do
            if Player[pc].getHandCount() > 0 then
                scaleHandZone(Player[pc], width, depth)
            end
        end
    end

    --Resizing table elements
    obj_side_top.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_bot.setScale({width, 1, 1})
    obj_side_lef.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_side_rig.setScale({depth, 1, 1})
    obj_surface.setScale({width, 1, depth})

    --Moving table elements to accomodate new scale
    obj_side_lef.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_rig.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,0})
    obj_side_top.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_side_bot.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg1.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    obj_leg2.setPosition({-width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg3.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset, depth2pos})
    obj_leg4.setPosition({ width2pos,tableHeightOffset,-depth2pos})
    self.setPosition(obj_leg4.positionToWorld({-22.12, 8.74,-19.16}))
    --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
    --obj_surface.setPosition({0,tableHeightOffset,0})
end

--Move hand zone, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function moveHandZone(p, width2pos, depth2pos)
    local widthX = obj_side_rig.getPosition().x
    local depthZ = obj_side_top.getPosition().z
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local pos = handT.position
        local y = handT.rotation.y

        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            if pos.z > 0 then
                pos.z = pos.z + depth2pos - depthZ
            else
                pos.z = pos.z - depth2pos + depthZ
            end
        else
            if pos.x > 0 then
                pos.x = pos.x + width2pos - widthX
            else
                pos.x = pos.x - width2pos + widthX
            end
        end

        --Only enabled when changing tableHeightOffset
        --pos.y = tableHeightOffset + 14

        handT.position = pos
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end


---Scales hand zones, p=player reference, facts are scaling factors
function scaleHandZone(p, width, depth)
    local widthFact = width / obj_side_top.getScale().x
    local depthFact = depth / obj_side_lef.getScale().x
    for i=1, p.getHandCount() do
        local handT = p.getHandTransform()
        local scale = handT.scale
        local y = handT.rotation.y
        if y<45 or y>320 or y>135 and y<225 then
            scale.x = scale.x * widthFact
        else
            scale.x = scale.x * depthFact
        end
        handT.scale = scale
        p.setHandTransform(handT, i)
    end
end



--Information gathering



--Checks if a color is promoted or host
function permissionCheck(color)
    if Player[color].host==true or Player[color].promoted==true then
        return true
    else
        return false
    end
end

--Locates a string saved within memory file
function findInImageDataIndex(...)
    for _, str in ipairs({...}) do
        for i, v in ipairs(tableImageData) do
            if v.url == str or v.name == str then
                return i
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end

--Locates a button with a helper function
function findButton(obj, func)
    if func==nil then error("No func supplied to findButton") end
    for _, v in ipairs(obj.getButtons()) do
        if func(v) then
            return v
        end
    end
    return nil
end



--Creation of buttons/inputs



function createOpenCloseButton()
    local tooltip = "Open Table Control Panel"
    if controlActive then
        tooltip = "Close Table Control Panel"
    end
    self.createButton({
        click_function="click_toggleControl", function_owner=self,
        position={0,0,0}, rotation={-45,0,0}, height=400, width=400,
        color={1,1,1,0}, tooltip=tooltip
    })
end

function createSurfaceInput()
    local currentURL = obj_surface.getCustomObject().diffuse
    local nickname = ""
    if findInImageDataIndex(currentURL) ~= nil then
        nickname = tableImageData[findInImageDataIndex(currentURL)].name
    end
    self.createInput({
        label="Nickname", input_function="none", function_owner=self,
        alignment=3, position={0,0,2}, height=224, width=4000,
        font_size=200, tooltip="Enter nickname for table image (only used for save)",
        value=nickname
    })
    self.createInput({
        label="URL", input_function="none", function_owner=self,
        alignment=3, position={0,0,3}, height=224, width=4000,
        font_size=200, tooltip="Enter URL for tabletop image",
        value=currentURL
    })
end

function createSurfaceButtons()

        label="Tabletop Surface Image", click_function="none",

    --Functional
    self.createButton({
        label="Apply Image\nTo Table", click_function="click_applySurface",

        label="Save Image\nTo Memory", click_function="click_saveSurface",

    })

        label="Load From Memory", click_function="none",
        position={0,0,5.5}, height=0, width=0, font_size=300, font_color={1,1,1}
    })
    --Saves, created dynamically from memory file
    for i, memoryEntry in ipairs(tableImageData) do
        --Load
        local funcName = i.."loadMemory"
        local func = function(x,y) click_loadMemory(x,y,i) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)
        self.createButton({
            label=memoryEntry.name, click_function=funcName,

            label="DELETE", click_function=funcName,

            font_size=160, font_color={1,0,0}, color={0.8,0.8,0.8}
        })
    end
end

volatility = 0

function click_textbox(dummy, dummy, value, selected) --dummy values to take up input params
    if selected == false then
        volatility = value
    end
end

function onLoad()
       
    self.createInput({
        input_function = "click_textbox",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "0",
        alignment      = 3,
        position       = {0.00, 0.23, -0.42},
        scale          = {1, 1, 1},
        width          = 120,
        height         = 70,
        font_size      = 45,
        color          = {0.16, 0.12, 0.1},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
        value          = "00",
        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},
        validation     = 2,
        tooltip        = "Percentage value to increase or decrease the Investment value."
    })

    scale = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5}
    fontSizeFor5 = 40 * 2

    params = {
        click_function = "minuspercent",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "-%",

        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},
        width          = 150 * 2,
        height         = 60 * 2,
        font_size      = fontSizeFor5,
        scale          = scale,
        color          = {0.7, 0.18, 0.18},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    }
    self.createButton(params)

    params = {
        click_function = "pluspercent",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "+%",

        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},

        height         = 60 * 2,
        font_size      = fontSizeFor5,
        scale          = scale,
        color          = {0.18, 0.7, 0.18},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    }
    self.createButton(params)

    params = {
        click_function = "maxinvest",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "300",
        position       = {0.30, 0.23, -0.58},
        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},
        width          = 150 * 2,
        height         = 60 * 2,
        font_size      = fontSizeFor5,
        scale          = scale,
        color          = {0.18, 0.18, 0.7},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    }
    self.createButton(params)

    params = {
        click_function = "double",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "x2",
        position       = {0.00, 0.23, -0.58},
        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},
        width          = 150 * 2,
        height         = 60 * 2,
        font_size      = fontSizeFor5,
        scale          = scale,
        color          = {0.18, 0.18, 0.7},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    }
    self.createButton(params)

    params = {
        click_function = "triple",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = "x3",
        position       = {-0.30, 0.23, -0.58},
        rotation       = {0, 180, 0},
        width          = 150 * 2,
        height         = 60 * 2,
        font_size      = fontSizeFor5,
        scale          = scale,
        color          = {0.18, 0.18, 0.7},
        font_color     = {1, 1, 1},
    }
    self.createButton(params)

end

function minuspercent()
    self.Counter.setValue(round(self.Counter.getValue() * (1 - (volatility/100))), 0.1)
end

function pluspercent()
    self.Counter.setValue(round(self.Counter.getValue() * (1 + (volatility/100))), 0.1)
end

function maxinvest()
    self.Counter.setValue(300)
end

function double()
    self.Counter.setValue(self.Counter.getValue() * 2)
end

function triple()
    self.Counter.setValue(self.Counter.getValue() * 3)
end

function round(num, dec)
    local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
    return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end function onload()
  refresh()
end

function refresh()
  self.clearButtons()
  soundobj=getObjectFromGUID(self.getDescription())
  loopcnt=0 trigcnt=0
  if soundobj~=nil and soundobj.name=='Custom_Assetbundle' then
    if soundobj.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffects()~=nil then loopcnt=#soundobj.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffects() loopobj=soundobj end
    if soundobj.AssetBundle.getTriggerEffects()~=nil then trigcnt=#soundobj.AssetBundle.getTriggerEffects() trigobj=soundobj end
    scalefactor=(loopcnt+trigcnt)/15
    if scalefactor>3 then scalefactor=3
    elseif scalefactor<0.5 then scalefactor=0.5
    end
    self.setScale({3.18,1,3*scalefactor})
    if soundobj.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffects() then
      for i,v in ipairs(soundobj.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffects()) do
        makeLoopButton(v.index,v.name,0)
      end
    end
    if soundobj.AssetBundle.getTriggerEffects() then
      for i,v in ipairs(soundobj.AssetBundle.getTriggerEffects()) do
        makeTriggerButton(v.index+loopcnt,v.name,loopcnt)
      end
    end
  end
  if scalefactor==nil then scalefactor=1 end
  local button1 = {}
  button1.click_function = 'refresh'
  button1.function_owner = self
  button1.label = '!'
  button1.position = {2.15,0.175,-1.4}
  button1.rotation = {0,0,0}
  button1.width = 100
  button1.height = 100
  button1.font_size = 100
  self.createButton(button1)
end

function onCollisionEnter(collision_info)
  if collision_info.collision_object.name=='Custom_Assetbundle' then
    self.setDescription(collision_info.collision_object.guid)
    self.setName(collision_info.collision_object.getName())
    refresh()
  end
end

function makeLoopButton(vindex,vname,vindexoffset)
  local button1 = {}
  button1.click_function = 'loop'..vindex-vindexoffset
  button1.function_owner = self
  button1.label = wrap(vname,12)
  if row==nil then row=0 end
  if vindex%5==0 then row=vindex/5 end
  column=vindex
  if vindex>=5 then column=vindex-5 end
  if vindex>=10 then column=vindex-10 end
  if vindex>=15 then column=vindex-15 end
  if vindex>=20 then column=vindex-20 end
  if vindex>=25 then column=vindex-25 end
  if scalefactor>1 then rowspaceadj=0.7 else rowspaceadj=1 end
  button1.position = {-1.6+(column*0.8),0.175,-0.8-(scalefactor/10)+(row*0.9*rowspaceadj)}
  button1.rotation = {0,0,0}
  button1.width = 400
  if scalefactor>1 then
    button1.height = 400/(scalefactor)
  else
    button1.height = 400
  end
  button1.font_size = 65
  self.createButton(button1)
end

  local button1 = {}
  button1.click_function = 'trigger'..vindex-vindexoffset

  button1.label = wrap(vname,12)

  if vindex>=10 then column=vindex-10 end

  if vindex>=20 then column=vindex-20 end

  if scalefactor>1 then rowspaceadj=0.7 else rowspaceadj=1 end
  button1.position = {-1.6+(column*0.8),0.175,-0.8-(scalefactor/10)+(row*0.9*rowspaceadj)}
  button1.rotation = {0,0,0}
  button1.width = 400
  if scalefactor>1 then
    button1.height = 400/(scalefactor)
  else
    button1.height = 400
  end
  button1.font_size = 65
  self.createButton(button1)

function wrap(str, limit, indent, indent1)
  indent = indent or ""
  indent1 = indent1 or indent
  limit = limit or 72
  local here = 1-#indent1
  return indent1..str:gsub("(%s+)()(%S+)()",
                          function(sp, st, word, fi)
                            if fi-here > limit then
                              here = st - #indent
                              return "\n"..indent..word
                            end
                          end)
end

function onLoad(str)
--In code settings--
    invertcoin=false   --old negative value is now positive and old positive value is now negative
    coinzero=-2        --0 > toggle when beond zero, -1 > zero is negative, 1 > zero is positive, 2 > toggle when reached zero, -2 > zero is special
    autoconnect=true   --allow autoconnecting by putting counters next to each other
    howfaraconn=0.6    --how far autoconnect works (object scale affects this)
    showcalcround=true --show autocalculation list on hover
--End of settings---
    savechanged=false
    local start=false
    SETTINGS_POS=string.find(self.script_code,"--End of settings---")
    self.setVar("SETTINGS_POS",SETTINGS_POS)
    if str != "" and str != nil then
        local data=JSON.decode(str)
        for name, info in pairs(data) do
            if name == "extendCounterObjs" then
                if type(info).."" == "table" then
                    if #info > 1 then
                        extendCounterObjs={}
                        for _, guid in ipairs(info) do
                            local obj=getObjectFromGUID(guid)
                            if obj then
                                table.insert(extendCounterObjs,obj)
                            end
                        end
                        if #extendCounterObjs < 2 then
                            extendCounterObjs=nil
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if name == "extendCounterCoin" then
                local obj=getObjectFromGUID(info)
                if obj then
                    extendCounterCoin=obj
                end
            end
            if name == "autoCalculateList" then
                if type(info).."" == "table" then
                    if #info > 2 then
                        autoCalculateList={}
                        for _, guid in ipairs(info) do
                            local obj=getObjectFromGUID(guid)
                            if obj then
                                table.insert(autoCalculateList,obj)
                            end
                        end
                        if #autoCalculateList < 3 then
                            autoCalculateList=nil
                        else
                            start=true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    self.setVar("whatIAm","Counter")
    self.setVar("Supports_getTotalValue",true)
    self.setVar("whatIAmSpecfically","[finmod]Advanced Counter Mark II")
    watchDesc()
    updateContextMenu()
    if start then autoCalculateActive=false; autocalcOperation(); end
end

function onSave()
    local objs={}
    local autol={}
    local rettab={}
    local coin
    if savechanged then
        if extendCounterCoin then
            coin=extendCounterCoin.getGUID()
        end
        if type(extendCounterObjs).."" == "table" then
            for _, obj in ipairs(extendCounterObjs) do
                if obj then
                    table.insert(objs,obj.getGUID())
                end
            end
        end
        if type(autoCalculateList).."" == "table" then
            for _, obj in ipairs(autoCalculateList) do
                if obj then
                    table.insert(autol,obj.getGUID())
                end
            end
        end
        if #objs > 1 then
            rettab["extendCounterObjs"]=objs
        end
        if coin then
            rettab["extendCounterCoin"]=coin
        end
        if #autol > 2 then
            rettab["autoCalculateList"]=autol
        end
        savechanged=false
        return JSON.encode(rettab)
    else
        return self.script_state
    end
end

function getAnyVar(tab)
    return _G[tab[1]]
end
function setAnyVar(tab)
    _G[tab[1]]=tab[2]
end

function onHover(col)
    if autoCalculateList != nil and showcalcround then
        local showme={  color=Color(1,1,1), thickness=0.1, rotation=Vector(0,0,0), points={} }
        local pos=self.getPosition()+Vector(0,0.5,0)
        local ipos=self.getPosition()-Vector(0,1.5,0)
        local prevvec=vectorToLocal(pos,self.getPosition(),self.getScale(),self.getRotation())
        local list={}
        i=#autoCalculateList
        while i > 0 do
            showme.color=Color(1,1,1):lerp(Color(0,0,1),(#autoCalculateList-i)/(#autoCalculateList-1))
            table.insert(list,makecopytab(showme,1))
            list[#autoCalculateList-i+1].points[1]=prevvec
            local obj=autoCalculateList[i]
            list[#autoCalculateList-i+1].points[2]=vectorToLocal(obj.getPosition(),ipos,self.getScale()*Vector(3,3,3),self.getRotation())
            prevvec=list[#autoCalculateList-i+1].points[2]
            i=i-1
        end
        self.setVectorLines(list)
        Wait.time(function() self.setVectorLines() end, 3.0)
    end
end
function onPickUp(color)
    if type(extendCounterObjs).."" == "table" then
        local amount=#extendCounterObjs
        local selob=Player[color].getSelectedObjects()
        if selob then
            if #selob == amount then
                for i=1, amount do
                    local test = false
                    for x=1, amount do
                        if selob[i] == extendCounterObjs[x] then
                            test=true
                        end
                    end
                    if test then return end
                end
            end
        end
        for i, obj in ipairs(extendCounterObjs) do
            if obj then

function checkConnections()
    local finallist={self}
    local bd=self.getBounds()
    local scale=self.getScale()
    local x=bd.size.x / 2.0
    local rot=self.getRotation()
    local left=Vector(-(x+(howfaraconn+0.5)*scale.x),-bd.offset.y,0):rotateOver("y",rot.y)
    local right=Vector()-left
    local cpos=self.getPosition()
    local tmppos=cpos
    local test=true
    while test do
        local list=findInRadiusBy(tmppos+left,1.0,function(obj) return obj.type == "Counter" end)
        if #list > 0 then
            tmppos=list[1].getPosition()
            bd=list[1].getBounds()
            scale=list[1].getScale()
            x=bd.size.x / 2.0
            left=Vector(-(x+(howfaraconn+0.5)*scale.x),-bd.offset.y,0):rotateOver("y",rot.y)
            table.insert(finallist,list[1])
        else
            test=false
        end
    end
    tmppos=cpos
    test=true
    while test do
        local list=findInRadiusBy(tmppos+right,1.0,function(obj) return obj.type == "Counter" end)
        if #list > 0 then
            tmppos=list[1].getPosition()
            bd=list[1].getBounds()
            scale=list[1].getScale()
            x=bd.size.x / 2.0
            right=Vector(x+(howfaraconn+0.5)*scale.x,-bd.offset.y,0):rotateOver("y",rot.y)
            table.insert(finallist,1,list[1])
        else
            test=false
        end
    end
    if #finallist <= 1 then return end
    local coin=extendCounterCoin
    for i=1,#finallist do
        if string.sub(finallist[i].script_code,finallist[i].getVar("SETTINGS_POS") or SETTINGS_POS) == string.sub(self.script_code,SETTINGS_POS) or finallist[i].getVar("whatIAmSpecfically") == "[finmod]Advanced Counter Mark II" then
            finallist[i].call("extflash",{finallist})
            if coin then
                finallist[i].call("scriptcoin",{coin,invertcoin,coinzero})
            end
        else
            local guid=finallist[i].getGUID()
            for i=1, 7 do
                Wait.time(function() getObjectFromGUID(guid).highlightOn(Color(0,1,0),0.2) end,(-0.2)+0.4*i)
            end
        end
    end
    printToAll("Connected ".. #finallist .." counters.")
end

            end
        else
            if autoCalculateList[i].getVar("whatIAmSpecfically") != "[finmod]Advanced Counter Mark II" then

                end
            end

            Wait.time(function() getObjectFromGUID(guid).highlightOn(Color(1,1,1),0.45) end, i*0.3+0.7)
        end
        i=i+1
    end
    log(autoCalculateList)
    table.remove(autoCalculateList) -- remove self
    if #autoCalculateList > 1 and ((#autoCalculateList % 2) == 1) then
        autoCalculateActive=false
        autocalcOperation()
    else
        printToAll("[ff0000]ERROR:[-] ".. #autoCalculateList .." long list failed (dropped). Select odd number of objects, starting from counter, then finally select counter to display the value (paired number of selected objects).")
        autoCalculateList=nil
    end
end

function autocalcOperation()
    if autoCalculateList != nil then
        if not autoCalculateActive then
            autoCalculateActive=true
            local i=1
            local lastop
            local mycalc,myminus=0,false
            while i <= #autoCalculateList do
                local isop=i%2 == 0
                if isop then
                    if i == #autoCalculateList then
                        printToAll("[ff0000]ERROR:[-]autocalcOperation: last one cannot be operator.")
                    end
                    local test=isOperator(autoCalculateList[i].getName())
                    if test then
                        lastop=autoCalculateList[i].getName()
                    else
                        test=isOperator(autoCalculateList[i].getDescription())
                        if test then
                            lastop=autoCalculateList[i].getDescription()
                        else
                            printToAll("[ff0000]ERROR:[-]autocalcOperation: ".. i .." index selected not an operator. (dropped)")
                            table.remove(autoCalculateList,i)
                            i=i-1
                        end
                    end
                else
                    local var,minus,index
                    if autoCalculateList[i].getVar("whatIAmSpecfically") != "[finmod]Advanced Counter Mark II" and not autoCalculateList[i].getVar("Supports_getTotalValue") then
                        var=autoCalculateList[i].getValue()
                        minus=var < 0
                    else
                        if string.sub(autoCalculateList[i].script_code,autoCalculateList[i].getVar("SETTINGS_POS") or SETTINGS_POS) != string.sub(self.script_code,SETTINGS_POS) then
                            var,minus,index=autoCalculateList[i].call("getTotalValue")
                            var=math.floor(var / math.pow(10000,index-1))
                        else
                            var,minus,index=autoCalculateList[i].call("getTotalValue")
                            var=math.floor(var / math.pow(10000,index-1))
                        end
                    end
                    if i == 1 then
                        mycalc=math.abs(var)
                        myminus=minus
                    else
                        mycalc,myminus=rawCalcOperation(lastop,mycalc,var,myminus,minus)
                    end
                end
                i=i+1
            end
            setTotalValue({mycalc,myminus})
            autoCalculateActive=false
            autoCalculateWait=Wait.time(autocalcOperation,1.0)
        end
    end
end

function getTotalValue()
    if extendCounterObjs == nil then
        if extendCounterCoin == nil then
            local var=tonumber(self.getValue()) or 0
            return var,var < 0,1
        else
            local minus
            local vec=vectorRotate(Vector(0,1,0),extendCounterCoin.getRotation()) 
            if vec.y <= -0.15 then minus=false != invertcoin
            elseif vec.y >= 0.15 then minus=true != invertcoin
            else minus=false != invertcoin end
            return (minus and -math.abs(tonumber(self.getValue()) or 0) or math.abs(tonumber(self.getValue()) or 0)),minus,1
        end
    else
        local meCounterIndex
        local i=1
        while i <= #extendCounterObjs do
            if extendCounterObjs[i] == self then
                meCounterIndex=i
            end
            if extendCounterObjs[i] ==  nil then
                log("linked counter operation, counter "..i.." removed.")
                table.remove(extendCounterObjs,i)
                i=i-1
            end
            i=i+1
        end
        if #extendCounterObjs <= 1 then
            printToAll("[ff0000]ERROR:[-]Only one counter left, and started linkked counter operation.")
            extendCounterObjs=nil
            updateContextMenu()
            return getTotalValue()
        end
        if meCounterIndex == nil then printToAll("[ff0000]ERROR:[-]did not find index of counter."); return nil,nil,nil end
        local var=0
        i=#extendCounterObjs
        local minus
        if extendCounterCoin == nil then
            minus=false
        else
            local vec=vectorRotate(Vector(0,1,0),extendCounterCoin.getRotation())
            if vec.y <= -0.15 then minus=false != invertcoin
            elseif vec.y >= 0.15 then minus=true != invertcoin
            else minus=false != invertcoin end
        end
        while i >= 1 do
            var=math.abs(tonumber(extendCounterObjs[i].getValue()) or 0) + var * 10000
            i=i-1
        end
        return (minus and -var or var),minus,meCounterIndex
    end
end
function setTotalValue(tab)
    local var,minus
    if type(tab).."" == "table" then
        if #tab >= 1 then
            var=tab[1]
        end
        if #tab >= 2 then
            minus=tab[2]
        end
    else
        log("setTotalValue:not a table")
    end
    if extendCounterObjs == nil then
        if minus == nil then minus=var < 0 end
        if minus and extendCounterCoin == nil then
            var=math.abs(var) % (minus and 1000 or 10000)
        elseif extendCounterCoin != nil then
            var=math.abs(var) % 10000
            local tmpminus
            if invertcoin then
                tmpminus=not minus
            else
                tmpminus=minus
            end
            if coinzero == -2 and var == 0 then
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,90))
            elseif tmpminus then
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,0))
            else
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,180))
            end
        end
        if extendCounterCoin == nil then
            self.setValue(minus and -var or var)
        else
            self.setValue(var)
        end
    else
        if minus == nil then minus=var < 0 end
        var=var % math.pow(10000,#extendCounterObjs)
        if minus and extendCounterCoin == nil then
            var=math.pow(10000,#extendCounterObjs) - var
        elseif extendCounterCoin != nil then
            local tmpminus
            if invertcoin then
                tmpminus=not minus
            else
                tmpminus=minus
            end
            if coinzero == -2 and var == 0 then
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,90))
            elseif tmpminus then
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,0))
            else
                extendCounterCoin.setRotation(Vector(0,0,180))
            end
        end
        i=#extendCounterObjs
        while i >= 1 do
            extendCounterObjs[i].setValue(math.floor(var/math.pow(10000,i-1)) % 10000)
            i=i-1
        end
    end
end

function wrapCalcOperation(tab)
    local a,b,c,d,e
    if type(tab).."" == "table" then
        if #tab >= 1 then
            a=tab[1]
        end
        if #tab >= 2 then
            b=tab[2]
        end
        if #tab >= 3 then
            c=tab[3]
        end
        if #tab >= 4 then
            d=tab[4]
        end
        if #tab >= 5 then
            e=tab[5]
        end
        for name, item in pairs(tab) do
            if name == "oplett" then
                a=item
            elseif name == "var" then
                b=item
            elseif name == "addable" then
                c=item
            elseif name == "minus" then
                d=item
            elseif name == "addmeg" then
                e=item
            end
        end
        local var,minus=rawCalcOperation(a,b,c,d,e)
        return var,minus
    else
        log("wrapCalcOperation:not a table")
        return nil,nil
    end
end

function rawCalcOperation(oplett,var,addable,minus,addneg)
    if minus == nil then
        if var < 0 then minus=true else minus=false end
    end
    if addneg == nil then
        if addable < 0 then addneg=true else addneg=false end
    end
    if isOperator(oplett) then
        -- if oplett == "+" or oplett == "-" then
            -- if oplett == "-" and minus then
                -- oplett="+"
            -- elseif oplett == "+" and minus then
                -- oplett="-"
            -- end
        -- end
    else
        log("rawCalcOperation:Wrong operator")
    end
    if minus == addneg then
        local pah
        if oplett == "-" and minus then oplett = "+" end
        pah,var=isOperator(oplett,var,addable)
    else
        local pah
        if oplett == "-" then oplett = "+" elseif oplett == "+" then oplett = "-" end
        if minus then -- addable positive, var negative
            pah,var=isOperator(oplett,var,addable)
        else -- addable negative, var positive
            pah,var=isOperator(oplett,var,addable)
        end
    end
    if coinzero == 0 then
        if var < 0 then
            minus=not minus
        end
    elseif coinzero == -1 then
        if var < 0 then
            minus=not minus
        elseif 0 == var then
            minus=true
        end
    elseif coinzero == 1 then
        if var < 0 then
            minus=not minus
        elseif 0 == var then
            minus=false
        end
    elseif coinzero == 2 then
        if var >= 0 then
            minus=not minus
        end
    elseif coinzero == -2 then
        if var < 0 then
            minus=not minus
        end
    end
    return math.abs(var),minus
end

function isOperator(str,a,b)
    if type(str).."" == "string" then
        if string.len(str) == 1 then
            if type(a).."" == "number" and type(b).."" == "number" then
                a,b=math.abs(a),math.abs(b)
                if str == "+" then
                    return true,a+b
                elseif str == "-" then
                    return true,a-b
                elseif str == "*" then
                    local pa,pb=a%100000000,b%100000000
                    local ba,bb=(a-pa)/100000000,(b-pb)/100000000
                    return true,pa*pb + ((ba*pb)%100000000)*100000000 + ((bb*pa)%100000000)*100000000
                elseif str == "/" then
                    return true,math.floor(a/b)
                elseif str == "&" then
                    local ta,tb=a,b
                    local i=0
                    local num=0
                    while ta != 0 and tb != 0 do
                        local ca,cb=ta%2,tb%2
                        ta,tb=(ta-ca)/2,(tb-cb)/2
                        if ca == cb and ca == 1 then
                            num=num+math.pow(2,i)
                        end
                        i=i+1
                    end
                    return true,num
                elseif str == "|" then
                    local ta,tb=a,b
                    local i=0
                    local num=0
                    while ta != 0 or tb != 0 do
                        local ca,cb=ta%2,tb%2
                        ta,tb=(ta-ca)/2,(tb-cb)/2
                        if ca == 1 or cb == 1 then
                            num=num+math.pow(2,i)
                        end
                        i=i+1
                    end
                    return true,num
                elseif str == "^" then
                    local ta,tb=a,b
                    local i=0
                    local num=0
                    while ta != 0 or tb != 0 do
                        local ca,cb=ta%2,tb%2
                        ta,tb=(ta-ca)/2,(tb-cb)/2
                        if (ca == 1 and cb == 0) or (ca == 0 and cb == 1) then
                            num=num+math.pow(2,i)
                        end
                        i=i+1
                    end
                    return true,num
                elseif str == "%" then
                    return true,a%b
                elseif str == "<" then
                    if b == 0 then return true,a end
                    return true,a * math.pow(2,b)
                elseif str == ">" then
                    if b == 0 then return true,a end
                    return true,math.floor(a / math.pow(2,b))
                elseif str == "p" then
                    return true,math.floor(math.pow(a,b))
                elseif str == "r" then
                    return true,math.floor(math.pow(a,1.0/b))
                end
            else
                if str == "+" then return true end
                if str == "-" then return true end
                if str == "*" then return true end
                if str == "/" then return true end
                if str == "&" then return true end
                if str == "|" then return true end
                if str == "^" then return true end
                if str == "%" then return true end
                if str == "<" then return true end
                if str == ">" then return true end
                if str == "p" then return true end
                if str == "r" then return true end
            end
        else
            log("isOperator:only one mark accepted ("..str..")")
        end
    else
        log("isOperator:only strings (of one character) accepted")
    end
    return false
end

function numinter(num,default,indentify)
    if type(num).."" == "number" then return num end
    if type(num).."" == "string" then
        local check="0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
        local out=nil
        if string.sub(num,1,1) == "0" then --hex or octaconal
            if string.sub(num,2,2) == "x" then --hex (base 16)
                if indentify then return "x" end
                local i=3
                local slen=string.len(num)
                while i <= slen do
                    local c=string.sub(num,i,i)
                    local f=string.find(check,c)
                    if f == nil then
                        log("numinter:hex:not regonized character (".. c ..")");
                    elseif f >= 1 and f <= 16 then
                        out=(out or 0) * 16 + f - 1
                    else
                        log("numinter:hex:character out of bounds (".. (f-1) .. ")")
                    end
                    i=i+1
                end
            else --octaconal (base 8)
                if indentify then return "0" end
                local i=2
                local slen=string.len(num)
                while i <= slen do
                    local c=string.sub(num,i,i)
                    local f=string.find(check,c)
                    if f == nil then
                        log("numinter:octa:not regonized character (".. c ..")");
                    elseif f >= 1 and f <= 8 then
                        out=(out or 0) * 8 + f - 1
                    else
                        log("numinter:octa:character out of bounds (".. (f-1) .. "),(".. c ..")")
                    end
                    i=i+1
                end
            end
        else
            if indentify then return "1" end
            out=tonumber(num)
        end
        if out == nil then
            return default
        else
            return out
        end
    end
    return default
end

function readDesc()
    local buttonlist={}
    local whatlist={}
    local desc=self.getDescription() or ""
    local txtstep=string.find(desc,",",1,true)
    if txtstep != nil then
        local prevstep
        repeat
            local poper=string.sub(desc,(prevstep or 0)+1,(prevstep or 0)+1)
            local test=isOperator(poper)
            local num=string.sub(desc,(prevstep or 0)+1+(test and 1 or 0),txtstep-1) or ""
            if string.len(num) != 0 then
                if test then
                    table.insert(whatlist,poper)
                else
                    table.insert(whatlist,"")
                end
                table.insert(buttonlist,num)
            end
            prevstep=txtstep
            txtstep=string.find(desc,",",txtstep+1,true)
        until txtstep == nil or txtstep == string.len(desc)
        if textstep == nil then
            local poper=string.sub(desc,(prevstep or 0)+1,(prevstep or 0)+1)
            local test=isOperator(poper)
            local num=string.sub(desc,(prevstep or 0)+1+(test and 1 or 0),string.len(desc)) or ""
            if string.len(num) != 0 then
                if test then
                    table.insert(whatlist,poper)
                else
                    table.insert(whatlist,"")
                end
                table.insert(buttonlist,num)
            end
        end
    elseif string.len(desc) > 0 then
        local poper=string.sub(desc,1,1)
        local test=isOperator(poper)
        local num=string.sub(desc,test and 2 or 1) or ""
        if string.len(num) != 0 then
            if test then
                table.insert(whatlist,poper)
            else
                table.insert(whatlist,"")
            end
            table.insert(buttonlist,num)
        end
    end
    return buttonlist,whatlist
end

function makecopytab(tab,depth)
    local mydepth=depth or 0
    if mydepth < 0 then
        log("this should not have been called. makecopytab")
        log(tab)
        return nil
    end
    local newtab={}
    if type(tab).."" == "table" then
        for x, val in pairs(tab) do
            if type(x).."" == "number" then
                if type(tab[x]).."" == "table" then
                    if type(tab[x].x).."" == "number" and type(tab[x].y).."" == "number" and type(tab[x].z).."" == "number" then
                        table.insert(newtab,x,Vector(tab[x]))
                    else
                        if mydepth > 0 then
                            table.insert(newtab,x,makecopytab(tab[x],mydepth-1))
                        else
                            table.insert(newtab,x,{})
                        end
                    end
                else
                    table.insert(newtab,x,tab[x])
                end
            elseif type(x).."" == "string" then
                if type(tab[x]).."" == "table" then
                    if type(tab[x].x).."" == "number" and type(tab[x].y).."" == "number" and type(tab[x].z).."" == "number" then
                        newtab[x]=Vector(tab[x])
                    else
                        if mydepth > 0 then
                            newtab[x]=makecopytab(tab[x],mydepth-1)
                        else
                            newtab[x]={}
                        end
                    end
                else
                    newtab[x]=tab[x]
                end
            end
        end
    else
        return tab
    end
    return newtab
end

function vectorRotate(vec,rot)
    return vec:rotateOver("z",rot.z):rotateOver("x",rot.x):rotateOver("y",rot.y)
end
function vectorIRotate(vec,rot)
    return vec:rotateOver("y",rot.y):rotateOver("x",rot.x):rotateOver("z",rot.z)
end
function vectorToLocal(target,objvec,objscale,objrot)
    local copy=Vector(target)
    copy=copy-(objvec or Vector(0,0,0))
    copy=vectorIRotate(copy,(objrot or Vector(0,0,0)):inverse())
    local tmp=objscale or Vector(1,1,1)
    copy=Vector(copy.x / tmp.x,copy.y / tmp.y, copy.z / tmp.z)
    return copy
end
function wrapVectorToLocal(tab)
    return vectorToLocal(tab[1],tab[2],tab[3],tab[4])
end

function findInRadiusBy(pos, radius, func, debug) --by MrStump https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=752690530&searchtext=lua
    --if DEBUG then log(" findInRadiusBy(): just called") end
    local radius = (radius or 1)
    local objList = Physics.cast({
        origin=pos, direction={0,1,0}, type=2, size={radius,radius,radius},
        max_distance=0, debug=(debug or false)
    })

    local refinedList = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(objList) do
        if func == nil then
            if obj.hit_object.type != "Surface" then -- Finaryman Mod
                table.insert(refinedList, obj.hit_object)
            end
        else
            if func(obj.hit_object) and obj.hit_object.type != "Surface" then --Finaryman Mod
                table.insert(refinedList, obj.hit_object)
            end
        end
    end

    return refinedList
end

--[[ Find the most recent version of this counter by going to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2813676076
Customizable Counter by Jonathan Cox (aka JonGetsGames)

based on the Ludo Lodge Custom Counter Tokens by Ryan Langewisch which was
based on the excellent Universal Counter Tokens by MrStump

CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS EXPLANATION

  Counter Type -  This has three important effects:
                  1. The type will be added to the counter's name so hovering will tell what type of thing is being counted.
                  2. The type will be used when printing value changes to the chat box.
                  3. IMPORTANT - Only counters with identical "type" will be able to transact with each other (explained below)

  Money Sybol - Only one character limit, if a symbol (like $) is placed here then this will be added to the counter
                value AND the "type" will no longer show in the chat box updates, instead this symbol is used.

  Show 'Type' on counter - displays the 'Type' name on the counter, underneath the value.

  Owner of this counter - This value is used for naming the counter when you hover over it as well as affecting
                          the text in the chat when the value changes.

  Print value changes to: - If "no players" then nothing is sent to chat. If "everyone" then the value change is sent to chat and
                            every player will see it. If "just you" then the value change is sent to chat and only you will see it.
                            If either "+ totals" option is selected, the phrase sent to chat will show the original and new values.

  Background color - Changes the background color of the counter.

  Value color - Changes the counter value number color.

  Shown adjustment buttons - Provides 4 options for which +/- buttons are shown on the counter.

  Transaction Options below - everything under this will only relate to how this counter transacts with other counters or the Supply

  Default transaction target - This shows a list of all counters that share this counter's "type", and always
                               also has "Infinite Supply" as an option. Infinite supply means the counter doesn't transact
                               with any other counter. If any other counter is selected, then this counter will default to spending
                               or sending it's value changes to that default counter.

  Show transaction buttons - When checked, this will show buttons under this counter for the Default Transaction Target as well as all
                             other counters that share this counter's "type". By pressing on those trasnaction buttons you change where
                             this counter transacts it's value changes to.

  Transactable with others - When this is checked, other counters with the same "type" will list this counter as a button. If you don't want
                             other counters to interact with this one, then uncheck the box.

  Infinite Supply Name - This is the name that shows up on the Infinite Supply transaction button, if "Infinite Supply" is set to default.

  Transaction Button Name - This is the name that will show up on transaction buttons on OTHER counters, that they can use to transact
                            with this counter. It's different from "Owner of this counter" because sometimes it's nice to have the transaction
                            button's name be shorthand to make the button smaller. Example: New York Central could have a button name of NYC.

  Number of buttons per row - This is the number of transaction buttons, including the Infinite Supply button if that's default, that will
                              show up under this counter when "Show transaction buttons" is checked.

  Width of each transaction button - Change this value to modify how wide every transaction button is.

  Height of each transaction button - Change this value to modify how tall every transaction button is.
]]

function UpdateCounterGUIDs()
  -- Grabs all GUIDs for counters with the same "type" (set in customization menu) --
  -- Also counts the number of transaction buttons (including Infinite Supply if it's the default) --
  -- Also checks to see if any GUID matches this token, and removes that item from the list if it does --
  -- Also if any counter with a matching type is set to un-transactable (from customization menu) then it won't be added to the list --
  transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER = 0
  counter_GUIDs = {}

  table.insert(counter_GUIDs, default_transact_GUID)

  for _, object in ipairs(Global.getObjects()) do
    if object.getGMNotes() == self.getGMNotes() and object.getGUID() ~= self.getGUID() and object.getGUID() ~= default_transact_GUID then
      is_transactable = object.getVar("transactable")
      if is_transactable == true then
        if recursion_stopper_activated == false then
          Wait.time(function()
            object.setVar("recursion_stopper_activated", true)
            object.call("UpdateAfterCustomization")
            object.setVar("recursion_stopper_activated", false)
          end,0.1)
        end
        table.insert(counter_GUIDs, object.getGUID())
        transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER = transact_BUTTONS_NUMBER + 1
      end
    end
  end
end


function LedgerChange(gained_count, transact_name, current_click, previous_count)
-- Announces any value changes made on the counter, prints after a number of seconds (equal to wait_duration) have elapsed since the last button click
      -- figure out the number change and add to total transation for ledger --
      total_gained_count = total_gained_count + gained_count

      -- Defines the original value only the first time the button is pressed --
      if original_previous_value == nil then
        original_previous_value = previous_count
      end

      -- This only prints the ledger change once wait_duration number of seconds of no button presses have elapsed. --
      Wait.time(function()
        -- These will only equal if no more buttons have been pressed since the start of the Wait function --
        if current_click == click_count then
            -- This only prints if nothing has been printed already. Once it prints it sets to this to true and therefore only one ledger update happens even if multiple button presses happen to get there --
            if printed == false then
              string_to_print = ""
              if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
                shown_pos_value = total_gained_count.." "..self.getGMNotes()
                shown_neg_value = (total_gained_count*-1).." "..self.getGMNotes()
              else
                shown_pos_value = money_symbol..total_gained_count
                shown_neg_value = money_symbol..(total_gained_count*-1)
              end

              if total_gained_count > 0 then
                string_to_print = " gained "..shown_pos_value
                if transact_GUID ~= "Infinite Supply" then
                  string_to_print = string_to_print.." from "..transact_name
                end
              elseif total_gained_count < 0 then
                string_to_print = " paid "..shown_neg_value
                if transact_GUID ~= "Infinite Supply" then
                  string_to_print = string_to_print.." to "..transact_name
                end
              end

              if string.sub(ledger_option, -6) == "totals" then
                string_to_print = string_to_print.." ("..original_previous_value.." -> "..count..")"
              end

              if total_gained_count ~= 0 then
                if string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "everyone" then
                  string_to_print = counter_controller..string_to_print
                  printToAll(string_to_print, self.getColorTint())
                elseif string.sub(ledger_option, 1, 8) == "just you" then
                  string_to_print = "You"..string_to_print
                  counter_color = TintToText()
                  printToColor(string_to_print, counter_color, "White")
                end
              end

              printed = true
            end
            -- Reset the overall ledger amount for the next set --
            total_gained_count = 0
            original_previous_value = nil
        end

      end,wait_duration)

      -- this sets it up to print the next ledger change on future button presses --
      printed = false

      --starts a timer that makes sure the transaction buttons won't be reset automatically too soon after a value change
      reset_hold = true
      Wait.time(function()
        reset_hold = false
      end,20)
end


-- Add 1 to the count, update the value button, and potentially print the change to the ledger
function add_one(print_ledger)
  previous_count = count
    -- This changes the count value and then updates the actual counter number on the token
    count = math.min(count + 1, MAXIMUM_VALUE)
    updateValue()

    -- If the player is transacting with a company, this adjusts that company value to show the amount removed or added
    if transact_GUID ~= "Infinite Supply" and print_ledger ~= "no_ledger" then
      counter = getObjectFromGUID(transact_GUID)
      counter.call("subtract_one","no_ledger")
    end

    -- This stops the ledger from updating if this function was activated by a different counter transacting with it
    if print_ledger ~= "no_ledger" then
      -- This is used to track if a button has been clicked for the purpose of waiting to print the ledger.
      click_count = click_count + 1
      LedgerChange(1, GetCounterDetails(transact_GUID).name, click_count, previous_count)
    end
end

function ChangeTransactButtonColors(object, player_color, pressed_button_index, just_customized)
-- This updates the background color, font color, and height of each transaction button every time any transation button is pressed --
  -- If a button that has already been activated is clicked again, it reverts the transating target back to the bank --
  if transact_GUID == GetCounterDetails(counter_GUIDs[pressed_button_index]).GUID and just_customized == false then
    pressed_button_index = 1
  end
  -- This updates each transaction button based on their GUIDs in the array that created them.
  for button_index, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do
    if button_index == pressed_button_index then
      -- This sets the pressed button to the active state, which makes the button's font color equal the company background, and the button's background equal the company font color.
      -- Also decreases the buttons height to make it more obvious which button is activated.
      self.editButton({index = button_index + 2, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color})

      -- Same as above, but changes the big transaction display above the counter
      self.editButton({index = 2, label = "Transacting with\n"..GetCounterDetails(GUID).name, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color})

      -- This sets transact_GUID to match the GUID of the currently transacting company, this variable is used elsewhere --
      transact_GUID = GetCounterDetails(GUID).GUID
    else

      -- This resets a button back to it's unselected state, based on the company token's backgrounad and font colors --
      self.editButton({index = button_index + 2, color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color, font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color, height = transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT})
    end
  end

  last_button_pressed_index = pressed_button_index

end


function setCountFromDescription(player_color)
-- Check if the description is a number, and set the count to that number
-- This is activated from a right-click context option.
    local new_value = self.getDescription()
    if new_value != '' and type(tonumber(new_value)) == 'number' then
      self.setDescription('')
      previous_count = count

      -- This changes the count value and then updates the actual counter number on the token
        count = math.min(new_value, MAXIMUM_VALUE)
        count_change = count - previous_count
        updateValue()

        -- If the player is transacting with a company, this adjusts that company value to show the amount removed or added
        if transact_GUID ~= "Infinite Supply" and print_ledger ~= "no_ledger" then
          counter = getObjectFromGUID(transact_GUID)
          other_counter_value = counter.getVar("count")
          counter.call("SetValueTo",other_counter_value - count_change)
        end

        -- This stops the ledger from updating if this function was activated by a different counter transacting with it
        if print_ledger ~= "no_ledger" then
          -- This is used to track if a button has been clicked for the purpose of waiting to print the ledger.
          click_count = click_count + 1
          LedgerChange(count_change, GetCounterDetails(transact_GUID).name, click_count, previous_count)
        end

    else
      printToColor("You must enter a number into the description box in order to change the counter's value.", player_color)
    end
end

  -- Actually change the value of the counter to the amount indicated.

function updateValue()
-- Update the value button according to the current count

  -- Changes the font size depending on how many digits there are, so that the value fits on the counter well.
  value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

  -- If the Money Symbol customization is used, this adds that symbol to the front of the value shown.
  if money_symbol == "" or money_symbol == " " then
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
  else
    value_button_parameters.label = money_symbol .. tostring(count)
  end

  self.editButton(value_button_parameters)

  -- If someone changed the counter's name in the right-click field, this makes that name change real for the purposes of printing value changes.
  if self.getName() ~= counter_name then
    ChangeCounterName(player, self.getName(), id)
  end

  counter_name = self.getName()

end

function getValueButtonFontSize()
-- Return a font size based on the number of digits in the current count

  -- If Money Symbol customization is used, this adds 1 to the overall number of digits to account for it.
  local temp_count = count
  if money_symbol ~= "" and money_symbol ~= " " then
    temp_count = temp_count * 10
  end

  -- This checks the digit count and applies the correct variable size (that is set near the top of this code)
  if temp_count >= 0 and temp_count <= 9 then
      return ONE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 10 and temp_count <= 99 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >= 100 and temp_count <= 999 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count >=1000 and temp_count <= 9999 then
    return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -1 and temp_count >= -9 then
      return TWO_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -10 and temp_count >= -99 then
      return THREE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  elseif temp_count <= -100 and temp_count >= -999 then
      return FOUR_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  else
      return FIVE_DIGIT_FONT_SIZE
  end
end


function GetCounterDetails(GUID)
-- Returns a library with parameters about the counter associated with the passed GUID

  details = {GUID = GUID}

  -- If looking for details about a defaulted Infinite Supply then there is no token and therefore no GUID
  -- This sets the colors to the specified amount from variables at the top of this code for the bank.
  -- Otherwise, if it's not a bank then it returns information about the indicated company counter token.
  if GUID == "Infinite Supply" then
    details.name = "the ".. infinite_supply_name
    details.transaction_button_name = infinite_supply_name
    details.color = bank_background_color
    details.font_color = bank_font_color
  elseif GUID ~= nil then
    counter = getObjectFromGUID(GUID)
    details.name = counter.getVar("counter_controller")
    details.transaction_button_name = counter.getVar("counter_transact_button_name")
    details.color = counter.getColorTint()

    if buttons_created_already == true then
      -- This grabs all button info from the counter associated with the passed GUID
      buttons = counter.getButtons()

      -- This grabs the font color of the value of the counter, and this could be used for setting a transaction button font color if they are used.
      for index, info in ipairs(buttons) do
        if index == 1 then
          details.font_color = info.font_color
        end
      end
    end
  end

  return details
end

-- Create buttons based on the button parameters
function createButtons()
    value_button_parameters.label = tostring(count)
    value_button_parameters.font_size = getValueButtonFontSize()

    -- This creates the big value number in the middle of the counter
    self.createButton(value_button_parameters)

    -- This creates the customization options button
    self.createButton(type_button_parameters)

    -- Everything within this If statement relates to having adjustment buttons on the counter.
    -- If this is set to "false" then the counter is only adjustable by outside means (specifically if this is a finite bank for other counters to interact with).
    if any_adjustment_buttons == true then
      -- Everything within this If statement relates to having the player counter transact with company counters.
      -- If this is set to "false" then this counter will not interact with any other counters of the same "type"
      if any_transaction_buttons == true then
        UpdateCounterGUIDs()

        -- This creates the "Transacting with" display button.
        self.createButton(transact_display_parameters)

        button_count = 1
        current_vertical_position = transact_BUTTON_VERTICAL_POSITION + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT * 0.00097)

        -- This cycles through every item in the counter_GUIDs table, that has GUIDs of all counters that have the same "type"
        for index, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do

          -- This makes sure the number of buttons per row matches the value shown in Customization.
          -- It also makes sure the buttons are evenly spaced out depending on the height specified in Customization.
          if button_count > buttons_per_row then
            current_vertical_position = current_vertical_position + (transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT* 0.0021)
            button_count = 1
          end

          -- This creates a new function for the transaction button to then interact with when changing the transaction target.
          _G['ClickFunction' .. index] = function(object, player_color)
            ChangeTransactButtonColors(object, player_color, index, false)
            TransactResetTimer()
          end

          -- This figures out what the central position is considering the button's width and the number of buttons in the row.
          transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION = (buttons_per_row - 1) * (transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.00105) * -1

          -- This bundles all the necessary information for the creation of the transaction button
          button_parameters = {
            click_function = 'ClickFunction' .. index,
            function_owner = self,
            label = GetCounterDetails(GUID).transaction_button_name,
            position = {  (transact_BUTTONS_START_HORIZONTAL_POSITION + (button_count - 1)*(transact_BUTTON_WIDTH * 0.0021)),
                           0.1,
                           current_vertical_position},
            width = transact_BUTTON_WIDTH,
            height = transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT,
            color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).color,
            font_color = GetCounterDetails(GUID).font_color,
            font_size = transact_BUTTON_FONT_SIZE,
            tooltip = "Transact with "..GetCounterDetails(GUID).name
          }
          self.createButton(button_parameters)
          button_count = button_count + 1
        end
      end

      -- Creates the lotto adjustment buttons.
      if lotto_buttons == true then
        self.createButton(plus_twohundredfifty_lotto_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(minus_twentypercent_button_parameters)
        self.createButton(jackpot_button_parameters)
	  end

function OpenCustomization(player, value, id)
-- Function to open the customization XML window

    -- This recreates the list of counters that share a type because new counters might have been made, or had types changed to match.
      UpdateCounterGUIDs()

    -- This changes the XML values to match the current values for all these customization attributes.
    self.UI.setAttribute("NumberOfRows", "text", buttons_per_row)
    self.UI.setAttribute("TransactionButtonWidth","text", transact_BUTTON_WIDTH)
    self.UI.setAttribute("TransactionButtonHeight","text", transact_BUTTON_HEIGHT)
    self.UI.setAttribute("FiftiesToggle", "isOn", player_buttons)
    self.UI.setAttribute("CounterType", "text", self.getGMNotes())
    self.UI.setAttribute("CounterName", "text", counter_controller)
    self.UI.setAttribute("CounterTransactButtonName", "text", counter_transact_button_name)
    self.UI.setAttribute("TransactionButtonsToggle", "isOn",any_transaction_buttons)
    self.UI.setAttribute("InfiniteSupplyName", "text", infinite_supply_name)
    self.UI.setAttribute("MoneySymbol", "text", money_symbol)
    self.UI.setAttribute("TransactableToggle", "isOn", transactable)
    self.UI.setAttribute("ShowTypeToggle", "isOn", show_type)
    --self.UI.setAttribute("TransactionsToggle", "isOn", transact_with_others)



    -- This grabs all XML data and puts it into a table.
    local xml = self.UI.getXmlTable()

    -- This builds the dropdown options for which ledger options are used and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[5].children[2].children[1].children = {}

    for _, value in ipairs(ledger_options) do
      if value == ledger_option then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_adjustment_buttons_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = value,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[5].children[2].children[1].children, add_adjustment_buttons_option)
    end

    -- This builds the dropdown options for changing the background color and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[6].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    for _, color in ipairs(color_options) do
      if trunc(self.getColorTint().r,1) == trunc(color.r,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().g,1) == trunc(color.g,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().b,1) == trunc(color.b,1) then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_BGcolor_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = color.color_name,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[6].children[2].children[1].children, add_BGcolor_option)
    end

    -- This builds the dropdown options for changing the shown value color and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[7].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    for _, color in ipairs(color_options) do
      if trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[1],1) == trunc(color.r,1) and trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[2],1) == trunc(color.g,1) and trunc(VALUE_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR[3],1) == trunc(color.b,1) then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_value_color_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = color.color_name,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[7].children[2].children[1].children, add_value_color_option)
    end


    -- This builds the dropdown options for which adjustment buttons are shown and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    xml[2].children[8].children[8].children[2].children[1].children = {}
    if any_adjustment_buttons == false then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "e"
    elseif player_buttons == true then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "r"
    elseif pool_buttons == true then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "l"
    elseif lotto_buttons == true then
      current_shown_adjustment_buttons = "o"
    end

    for _, value in ipairs(adjustment_button_options) do
      if string.sub(value, -1) == current_shown_adjustment_buttons then
        is_selected = true
      else
        is_selected = false
      end
      add_adjustment_buttons_option = {
          tag="Option",
          value = value,
          attributes={selected = is_selected},
          children={}
      }
      table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[8].children[2].children[1].children, add_adjustment_buttons_option)
    end

    UpdateCounterGUIDs()

    -- This builds the dropdown options for all the counters that can be set to the default transaction target and modifies the XML data table accordingly.
    add_default_option ={ tag="Option",
                  value = "Infinite Supply",
                  attributes={},
                  children={}
    }
    xml[2].children[8].children[10].children[2].children[1].children = {add_default_option}
    log(default_transact_GUID)
    for _, GUID in ipairs(counter_GUIDs) do
      if GUID ~= "Infinite Supply" then
        if default_transact_GUID == GUID then
          is_selected = true
        else
          is_selected = false
        end
        add_default_option = {
            tag="Option",
            value = GetCounterDetails(GUID).transaction_button_name ..": ".. GetCounterDetails(GUID).GUID,
            attributes={selected = is_selected},
            children={}
        }
        table.insert(xml[2].children[8].children[10].children[2].children[1].children, add_default_option)
      end
    end

    -- Replaces this counter's XML data with the modified data from the XML table that was created.
    self.UI.setXmlTable(xml)

    -- This un-hides the Customization XML window so that it's visible and able to be used.
    self.UI.show("Customization_Window")

    -- Changes the "Customization" button's colors to show that it's currently in use.
--    self.editButton({index=1, color=ADJUSTMENT_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR, font_color=ADJUSTMENT_BUTTON_BACKGROUND_COLOR})

    customization_open = true
end


function CloseCustomization(player, value, id)
-- This closes (hides) the Customization XML window.
    UpdateCounterGUIDs()

    self.UI.hide("Customization_Window")

    self.UI.hide("Customization_Explanations")
    customization_explanations = false

    customization_open = false
    UpdateAfterCustomization()

    -- Changes the "Customization" button's colors to show that it's no longer in use.
--    self.editButton({index=1, color=ADJUSTMENT_BUTTON_BACKGROUND_COLOR, font_color=ADJUSTMENT_BUTTON_FONT_COLOR})
end


function ToggleCustomizationExplanations()
-- This opens and closes the "help" panel which explains all the customization options --
  if customization_explanations == true then
    self.UI.hide("Customization_Explanations")
    customization_explanations = false
  else
    self.UI.show("Customization_Explanations")
    customization_explanations = true
  end
end

function TintToText()
  for _, color in ipairs(color_options) do
    if trunc(self.getColorTint().r,1) == trunc(color.r,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().g,1) == trunc(color.g,1) and trunc(self.getColorTint().b,1) == trunc(color.b,1) then
      bg_color = color.color_name
    end
  end

  return bg_color
end

-- This is a nice little function I found somewhere online that makes truncating a value simple to do.
function trunc(num, digits)
  local mult = 10^(digits)
  return math.modf(num*mult)/mult
end

-- This is an awesome little function I found online that "dumps" all information from a table into the chat box
-- and is entirely used for debugging and discovery. I kept it here because I may need it for future development on this counter.
function dump(o)
   if type(o) == 'table' then
      local s = '{ '
      for k,v in pairs(o) do
         if type(k) ~= 'number' then k = '"'..k..'"' end
         s = s .. '['..k..'] = ' .. dump(v) .. ','
      end
      return s .. '} \n'
   else
      return tostring(o)
   end
